title: MatijaShop
description: A lightweight GUI shop plugin that lets players spend Stars currency on items, blocks, tools, and spawners. Fully configurable with 8 categories and 100+ pre-configured items.

![Banner](https://hebbkx1anhila5yf.public.blob.vercel-storage.com/shop-v2ZfZeRYue9uxxJ8fOYjdAkTWOfTub.png)

# StarsShop - GUI Shop for Stars Currency

A clean and fully configurable GUI shop that integrates with the Stars currency system. Let players spend their hard-earned Stars on items, blocks, tools, and more.

---

## Features

- **8 Categories** - Blocks, Ores, Food, Tools, Redstone, Decoration, Special Items, Spawners
- **100+ Items** - Pre-configured with balanced prices
- **Clean GUI** - Organized layout with category icons and balance display
- **Visual Feedback** - Shows if player can/cannot afford items before purchase
- **Spawner Support** - Sell mob spawners with configurable entity types
- **Hex Colors** - Full gradient and hex color support in all messages
- **Sound Effects** - Audio feedback on purchase, error, and menu open
- **Pagination** - Automatic page system for large categories
- **Fully Configurable** - Every item, price, and message can be customized

## Commands

| Command | Description | Permission |
|---------|-------------|------------|
| `/shop` | Open the shop GUI | `starsshop.use` |
| `/store` | Alias for /shop | `starsshop.use` |
| `/shopadmin reload` | Reload configuration | `starsshop.admin` |

---

## Permissions

| Permission | Description | Default |
|------------|-------------|---------|
| `starsshop.use` | Access the shop | Everyone |
| `starsshop.admin` | Admin commands | OP |

---

## Categories

| Category | Items |
|----------|-------|
| Building Blocks | Stone, Logs, Bricks, Glass, Obsidian, and more |
| Ores & Minerals | Coal, Iron, Gold, Diamonds, Emeralds, Netherite |
| Food & Farming | Bread, Cooked Meats, Golden Apples, Seeds |
| Tools & Weapons | Diamond/Netherite Gear, Bows, Elytra |
| Redstone | Pistons, Hoppers, Repeaters, Observers |
| Decoration | Lanterns, Chains, Candles, Armor Stands |
| Special Items | Nether Star, Totems, Beacons, Shulker Boxes |
| Spawners | Zombie, Skeleton, Creeper, Blaze, Iron Golem |

---

## Configuration

All items and prices are configurable in `config.yml`:

```yaml
items:
  blocks:
    - material: STONE
      price: 5
      amount: 64
    - material: DIAMOND_BLOCK
      price: 500
      amount: 16
